set.body: Outcome: tracked portable manifest and checksum-verified on-demand downloader for current model assets; relocate actual large local weight files to mounted WD Passport with verified external custody and compatibility symlinks. Include CPU/MLX Whisper, Parakeet, MiniLM ONNX duplicates, Qwen3-VL and existing external Qwen3-ASR. Preserve historical pin/provenance bytes, data, runtimes and tiny test fixtures. Exact source pins/bytes/SHA256; no floating revisions, unsolicited inference, model upgrade or study reads. Acceptance: synthetic failure/atomicity/path/hash tests; actual pinned small-file download witness; independent exact-source review; live volume/open-file preflight; copy and rehash all targeted files before local replacement; final link readback, receipts and byte/accounting integrity. Claim exact tool/docs and selected weight paths. No merge/push/publication.
set.title: [media] Pin on-demand model downloads and relocate local weights to Passport
